audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Lucian levels 2, 3 and 6, contradicting the packet chart (Lucian, Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, Skill, Skill, Lucian), the 33.33% win rate, and the mirror, which already set rows 1-4 to Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, Skill.
audit.why: The page's own whys[1..4] describe exactly the packet shape — even at 2 as he charges W, his at 3-5, even at 6. Only the side tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 set to Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, Skill in both layers as matched pairs, ratings re-scaled to 5/4/4/5 (the inverse of the mirror's 5/6/6/5). Rows 0, 5 and 6 already agreed and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Do #3 called All Out 'the fifteen-second invitation'. All Out is 120/100/80s. phases[4] still described level 6 as Lucian's own spike.
audit.why: A fifteen-second count on a 120-second ultimate is off by a factor of eight and will get the player killed waiting for a window that is already long open, or walking into one that is not.
audit.corrected: Corrected to 120 seconds in dosFull[2].d and stated again in report[5].t; phases[4].why rewritten as the even, bait-the-R stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls K'Sante's W 'Ntofo Strikes' in wants.foe[0] and in the 'mid' block. Ntofo Strikes is his Q. His W is Path Maker. The same text calls Path Maker a 'block'.
audit.why: Riot's Path Maker text: 'K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies' — it is a damage-reduced charge that deals true damage, not a projectile block. A player told to wait for a block to expire misreads the entire trade. Also unaddressed from missingInteractions: Footwork (E) shields on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and eats the burst window, and All Out heals him.
audit.corrected: Path Maker named correctly and described as a damage-reduced charge in wants.foe[0], 'mid' and report[5].t; Footwork's shield and its 10s cooldown added to dontsFull[0].d; the Grievous Wounds requirement against All Out's healing added to dosFull[0].d.
sources: enemyKit K'Sante Q/W/E/R text and flags

edits.before: E online — dash-weave trades start now: spell, double-shot, dash out before his answer lands.
edits.after: It evens as he charges W — your double-shot still pressures, but he soaks one Piercing Light now.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: With Path Maker up he soaks your Q and eats the Lightslinger burst, then Q knockup into autos out-trades you.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track All Out — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Path Maker plus his auto grind wear you down every time you enter his 450 Q range, and you have no sustain.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Even at 6 — All Out strips his resists, so bait the R, E out of the isolation, then Culling him.

edits.before: Track K'Sante’s All Out: His duelist mode — fight the tank, never the duelist. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: All Out strips his resists on a 120s cooldown — bait it, then burst. Path Maker is a charge, not a block.

edits.before: K'Sante burns All Out on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: K'Sante burns All Out on nothing — that is a 120-second invitation.

edits.before: His duelist mode — fight the tank, never the duelist. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Fight the tank, never the duelist — and buy Executioner's, because All Out heals him through chip.

edits.before: That’s K'Sante’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Footwork shields on 10s and Path Maker soaks — force both out before you commit.

edits.before: Charge W (Ntofo Strikes) to block your Piercing Light and eat your Lightslinger burst with no damage
edits.after: Charge W (Path Maker) to soak your Piercing Light and eat the Lightslinger burst at reduced damage

edits.before: Levels 4-5 belong to him and I have to accept it. A K'Sante with W (Ntofo Strikes) blocks my key Piercing Light, tanks my burst, and his Q knockup into percent-HP autos out-trades my squishy frame every time I overstep. I farm with Q at max range, hold Relentless Pursuit purely as an escape from his Q, and refuse the extended melee he wants. At 6 it evens out: All Out lets him strip his own resists and isolate me against a wall, but if I bait the R and E-dash out of the isolation, The Culling can punish his stripped-resist window — just don't channel it while he can still W-block and dash onto me.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 belong to him and you have to accept it. A K'Sante with W (Path Maker) soaks your key Piercing Light, tanks your burst, and his Q knockup into heavy autos out-trades your squishy frame every time you overstep. Farm with Q at max range, hold Relentless Pursuit purely as an escape from his Q, and refuse the extended melee he wants. At 6 it evens out: All Out lets him strip his own resists and isolate you against a wall, but if you bait the R and E-dash out of the isolation, The Culling can punish his stripped-resist window — just don't channel it while he can still charge Path Maker and dash onto you.

notes: Two things left alone deliberately. (1) The content prose blocks early/mid/late are written in FIRST PERSON on this matchup, unlike the rest of the champion; I converted 'mid' to second person because I had to touch it for the Path Maker name error, but left 'early' and 'late' rather than make a unilateral voice change across the champion — flagging for a champion-level pass (same defect appears on lucian__kennen). (2) The page repeatedly claims K'Sante's passive autos deal 'percent-HP' damage. Riot's Dauntless Instinct text in the kit only says his abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next attack, and there is no percentHealth flag on the passive. I could not verify percent-max-HP damage from the kit and did not assert or remove it anywhere except the one sentence of 'mid' I was already rewriting, where I used 'heavy autos' instead. Recorded as unverified.
